_comment: Run 20261013 through the water-filled acrylic tube (the same size as 6-8 Oct) with three cameras: T0 = wand calibration. Lengths in mm, image coordinates in px (u = column, v = row, pixel centres at integers). Frames are counted by image number, the Phantom's count from the common trigger (the .chd header's FirstImageNo): a camera's file frame{k}.tif holds image number k + first_image. A copy of cases/cyl_20261008/config.json with this run's paths and frames; the detector settings are chosen from the Phase 0 survey (tests/p0d_wand_survey_*).
_cameras: Assumed the 8 Oct cameras (file sizes match: 1280 x 800 and 2048 x 1952, 8 bit); serials and FirstImageNo checked against the .chd headers by tests/p0a_files.py.

wand._comment: Assumed the wand of 6-8 Oct (10 mm, balls 3 and 4 mm); to confirm with the user.

tube._comment: As on 6-8 Oct (the user, 15 Oct: the same size cylinder): OD 7.9375 in, wall 0.125 in.

detect._comment: Candidates from the opening scans (tests/p0d_wand_survey_scan*, 15 Oct). cam1: ball radii about 33 / 45 px (8 Oct: 31 / 43); openings 49-55 px separate the balls from the rod (49: 21 of 21 frames, 51: 19). Radius range as 8 Oct (the balls are 5-8 % larger). Rod mask: 8 Oct's 28 px x 1.06 (the rod's half-width plus its blur).

2._comment: cam2: ball radii about 34 / 47 px; the openings that separate are larger than cam1's: 57 px best (18 of 21 frames), 51 px 13 of 21.

3._comment: cam3 (v2640, 13.5 um pixels): ball radii about 48-53 / 70-72 px (1.49-1.58 x cams 1-2; pixel-size ratio 1.48); openings 85-89 px separate 21 of 23 frames (8 Oct's 77 px: 16). Rod mask: 8 Oct's 42 px x 1.06.

accept._comment: The 6-8 Oct rules: a camera-frame is kept with two balls apart (the guard), both fits with an edge RMS at most edge_rms_max_px and an aspect ratio in aspect_range, and both sizes (sqrt(a b)) within size_tol of the camera's median for that ball. A frame enters the fit when at least min_cameras cameras keep it. aspect_range's upper end raised from 1.45 to 1.60 (plan D2, approved 15 Oct): cam1's ball images are stretched more by the tube (median 1.38; the survey's 20 frames at 1.45-1.58 had good edge fits).
